twin_agent.law: Twin Agent is permitted only in Velocity and Spry/BHPC. Other repos may use generalized page-quality lessons but must not fabricate Twin runs, manifests, or telemetry.

page_quality_patterns.rule: State the direct useful answer or definition near the top; do not require the reader or an LLM to infer the answer from a long introduction.
When the content contains a real repeatable methodology, give it a clear descriptive name and a standalone definition. Do not invent proprietary-sounding jargon without substance.
Use headings that directly match important user decisions, comparisons, costs, timelines, risks, procedures, and audience/use-case variants when those intents materially change the answer.
Prefer extractable steps, checklists, decision matrices, comparison tables, timelines, definitions, sourced statistics, templates, or calculators where they genuinely improve the answer.
Add persona or use-case sections only when the audience has a meaningfully different problem, workflow, constraint, or decision.
Before creating a new URL, test whether improving an existing near-match would create more expected citation yield with less duplication.
Do not create thin keyword-swap pages. Merge semantically equivalent queries into the strongest canonical surface unless distinct intent warrants a separate URL.
Never count page creation, indexing, impressions, LLM mentions, or backlinks as verified external citations. Evidence types remain separate.

verified_citation_evidence_rule: verified_external_citation events require provider/source, observed_at, surfaced_url, query_or_prompt, and evidence_ref. Missing proof may be stored only as a lower-confidence candidate event.
